newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Babcock CEO to be dismissed - papers.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Babcock CEO to be dismissed - papers.

text.p: The supervisory board of German engineering group Deutsche Babcock AG plans to dismiss management board chairman Heyo Schmiedeknecht soon, German media reported at the weekend.
The board will discuss the matter at a meeting on Monday, Cologne newspaper "Koelner Stadt-Anzeiger" and news magazine "Der Spiegel" reported, citing informed sources.
A spokeswoman for Deutsche Babcock contacted by Reuters declined to confirm the reports and said that Monday's board meeting was not an extraordinary one.
Spiegel said Schmiedeknecht had come under fire for purchasing companies which were now making losses.
After several restructuring attempts, Babcock's management in mid-1996 devised a reorganization for which the company's banks provided a credit line of about 600 million marks until the end of 1997.
But according to Spiegel, Schmiedeknecht last October reported a new liquidity gap of 100 million marks.
